_comment: Real-money products. Prices here are display only -- the STORE is the source of truth for what a player is actually charged, in their own currency. Showing a hardcoded '$4.99' to someone paying in zloty is how a store listing gets rejected.
name: Handful of Cores
text: A pocket of intact power cores.

name: Case of Cores
text: Sealed and stable. The usual way to fund a rebuild.

name: Crate of Cores
text: Enough to keep a foundry running for a season.

name: Reclaimer's Kit
text: A working loadout and the cores to improve it. One purchase per account.

name: Foundry Pass
text: Unlocks the premium track of the current season. Everything already earned is paid out immediately.

_comment2: Cores buy these. NOTHING random is ever sold for real money directly -- crates cost currency, which is both the platform-safe structure and the one that keeps published odds meaningful.
name: Alloy Shipment
text: Refined alloy, for refitting parts you already own.
